'''Parsec''' is a unit of distance used in [[astronomy]].

1 '''parsec''' is defined as the distance to an object with a '''par'''allax angle of 1 arc'''sec'''ond.

<ref>{{#cite:Q2558}}</ref>

== Conversion ==

$$
1 \mathrm{parsec}=3.261 \mathrm{ly},
$$
where $\mathrm{ly}$ denotes [[light-year]].

<ref>{{#cite:Q2558}}</ref>
